coreIdea: Buy the currently favored BTC 15m side with one resting maker bid below mid and hold any fill to resolution.

experiments.hypothesis: A simple resting maker bid on the higher-mid leg can acquire a fair-valued favorite cheaply enough to overcome adverse selection.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: Best but still negative: netEvPerMarket -0.07 over 1000 markets, 203 trades; wider discounts worsened monotonically to -0.13, and the 0.01 cell had 4 accidental taker fills.

Best cell turned positive: favThreshold 0.52 with discount 0.01 and size 20 reached netEvPerMarket 0.20 over 1000 markets, 451 markets played, 459 trades, and 56.54% win rate. Higher thresholds reduced participation and EV, with 0.65 producing no trades.

Best cell is size 40: netEvPerMarket 0.39 over 1000 markets, 451 markets played, 460 trades, gross 0.391, and 56.54% win rate. Size scaled nearly linearly from 10 -> 20 -> 40, so size is a stake knob rather than an edge-shaping parameter.

gateLog.note: Gate 1 passed: best cell netEv 0.39/mkt (run 177) > 0 at 1000-market coverage, with 451 markets played and 460 trades. Advisory: EV scales with size in this grid, but 10 accidental taker fills remain and larger size may face queue/liquidity realism limits.

Gate 2 failed: extended run 177 fell to netEv -0.39/mkt at 3000-market coverage, with 1459 markets played and 1483 trades. Advisory: the newest 1000-market edge did not survive the immediately older 2000 markets; win rate dropped from 56.54% at screen to 52.36% at confirm.

outcome.reason: Best cell (favThreshold 0.52, discount 0.01, size 40; run 177) met successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' at screen, but failed confirm with -0.39/mkt over 3000 markets (1483 trades, gross -0.389, fees $2.87 total), so the experiment recycles at gate 2.

experiments.hypothesis: The baseline's newest-window edge failed confirm because always entering on the first eligible tick mixes good and bad parts of the 15m episode; restricting the same mild-favorite maker bid to a stable elapsed-time window can preserve fill volume while avoiding the toxic early/late fills that made run 177 negative at 3000 markets.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: Best cell is startSec 0: netEvPerMarket 0.39 over 1000 markets, 451 markets played, 460 trades, gross 0.391, and 56.54% win rate. Delaying to 180 seconds stayed positive but weaker at 0.29/mkt; 60 seconds and 300 seconds were negative, so the next pass keeps immediate entry and tests only the stop boundary.

All tested stopSec values tied exactly: 300, 600, and 840 each reached netEvPerMarket 0.39 over 1000 markets, 451 markets played, 460 trades, gross 0.391, and 56.54% win rate. The stop boundary did not alter the fill set on this coverage, so the simplest tied value, 300, is selected for the stage-2 confirm extension.

gateLog.note: Gate 1 passed: best tied stopSec cell netEv 0.39/mkt (run 185) > 0 at 1000-market coverage, with 451 markets played and 460 trades. Advisory: all stopSec values tied exactly, so this experiment has not yet demonstrated that elapsed-time gating changes the baseline behavior.

Gate 2 failed: extended run 185 fell to netEv -0.39/mkt at 3000-market coverage, with 1459 markets played and 1483 trades. Advisory: the selected stop boundary tied the baseline at screen and also reproduced the baseline confirm failure, so elapsed-time stop gating did not fix the regime instability.

outcome.reason: Best tied cell (startSec 0, stopSec 300; run 185) met successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' at screen, but failed confirm with -0.39/mkt over 3000 markets (1483 trades, gross -0.389, fees $2.87 total). Because every stopSec value tied exactly at screen and the confirm result reproduced the baseline failure, elapsed-time stop gating does not repair the family.

experiments.hypothesis: If the favorite-maker screen was only a generic below-mid maker-fill artifact, mirroring the same one-shot resting bid onto the lower-mid leg should also show positive EV; if underdog fills are worse, the family should focus on favorite-specific flow rather than generic maker discount.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: The non-loss cell maxUnderdogMid 0.35 had zero trades and is not evidence. Among trading cells, 0.40 is least bad at netEvPerMarket -0.06 over 1000 markets with 14 trades and 28.57% win rate; wider underdog cutoffs increased participation but worsened sharply to -1.59/mkt at 0.48.

Best discount cell was still negative: discount 0.04 reached netEvPerMarket -0.04 over 1000 markets with 14 trades, all maker, and 28.57% win rate. Wider discount improved the tiny 0.40-cutoff sample from -0.06 at 0.01, but not enough to pass stage 1.

gateLog.note: Gate 1 failed: best trading cell netEv -0.04/mkt (run 194) <= 0 at 1000-market coverage, with only 14 trades. Advisory: underdog entries are directionally bad across active cutoffs; the zero-EV 0.35 cutoff had no trades and is not evidence.

outcome.reason: Best trading cell (maxUnderdogMid 0.40, discount 0.04; run 194) failed successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' with -0.04/mkt over 1000 markets and only 14 trades; broader underdog cutoffs were materially worse.

experiments.hypothesis: The immediate favorite maker entry failed confirm, but the delayed 180-second entry screen cell in 001 stayed positive; freezing that delayed entry as its own candidate tests whether avoiding early episode fills is enough to keep the simple favorite-maker idea alive.
experiments.successCriteria: Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

gateLog.note: Gate 1 passed: single delayed-entry run netEv 0.29/mkt (run 196) > 0 at 1000-market coverage, with 762 markets played and 764 trades. Advisory: participation is much higher than the immediate baseline and 17 taker fills remain; confirm is required because earlier favorite variants failed at 3000 markets.

Gate 2 failed: extended run 196 fell to netEv -0.37/mkt at 3000-market coverage, with 2391 markets played and 2400 trades. Advisory: delaying entry improved the screen but did not solve the same confirm instability seen in immediate favorite variants.

outcome.reason: Single run (favThreshold 0.52, discount 0.01, size 40, startSec 180, stopSec 840; run 196) met successCriteria 'Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' at screen, but failed confirm with -0.37/mkt over 3000 markets (2400 trades, gross -0.368, fees $7.49 total).

experiments.hypothesis: Delayed entry changed the fill set but still failed confirm; requiring a stronger favorite after the 180-second delay may filter out the older-history weak favorites that made the 3000-market result negative.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: Best 0.55 at +0.36 net EV/market over 1000 markets, 685 played, 687 trades; neighboring 0.52/0.60/0.65 cells stayed positive, so choose the local peak with adequate trade count.
Discount 0.02 and 0.04 tied at +0.40 net EV/market over 1000 markets; choose 0.02 because it preserved more coverage (662 trades vs 616) while 0.01 was lower at +0.36.

gateLog.note: Gate 1 passed: best delayed-threshold cell netEv 0.40/mkt (run 201, favThreshold 0.55, discount 0.02) > 0 at 1000-market coverage, with 662 trades. Advisory: the nearby 0.04 discount cell tied on rounded net EV with fewer trades, so confirm is required before trusting the screen.

Gate 2 failed: extended run 201 fell to netEv -0.24/mkt at 3000-market coverage, with 2051 markets played and 2051 trades. Advisory: the stricter delayed threshold improved the screen but still did not make favorite-maker entry stable across the immediately older 2000 markets.

outcome.reason: Best cell met successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' at screen, but failed confirm with -0.24 net EV/market over 3000 markets and 2051 trades.

experiments.hypothesis: The stronger delayed favorite entry screens positive but fails confirm when held to resolution; placing one maker take-profit sell after fills may capture favorable continuation while reducing resolution-time reversal exposure.
experiments.successCriteria: Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

gateLog.note: Gate 1 failed: run 205 netEv -1.18/mkt at 1000-market coverage, with 662 markets played and 1244 trades. Advisory: the take-profit sell greatly increased trade count and realized losses despite a high per-trade win rate, so this lifecycle worsened the screen.

outcome.reason: Single run failed successCriteria 'Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' with -1.18 net EV/market over 1000 markets and 1244 trades.

experiments.hypothesis: The delayed stronger-favorite entry fails confirm because stale bids are filled after the favorite weakens; canceling the resting bid when the chosen side drops by a few cents before fill may remove toxic fills while preserving favorable maker entries.
experiments.successCriteria: Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

gateLog.note: Gate 1 passed: run 207 netEv 0.22/mkt at 1000-market coverage, with 627 markets played and 627 trades. Advisory: canceling stale weakening bids reduced participation versus the uncanceled delayed-threshold screen and is still below that screen's +0.40/mkt, so confirm is required.

Gate 2 failed: extended run 207 fell to netEv -0.18/mkt at 3000-market coverage, with 1869 markets played and 1869 trades. Advisory: cancellation reduced participation versus the delayed-threshold confirm run but did not remove enough adverse selection to make the lifecycle robust.

outcome.reason: Single run met successCriteria 'Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' at screen, but failed confirm with -0.18 net EV/market over 3000 markets and 1869 trades.

experiments.hypothesis: The cancel-weakening rule improved confirm loss but still rested orders during early adverse movement; waiting for a short same-side stability confirmation before placing the maker bid may avoid weak favorites before they can fill.
experiments.successCriteria: Single run netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).
